turns.content: I need help crafting a LinkedIn post for the Fujifilm X100VI. Here are some product facts: it has a 23mm f/2 lens, a 26.1MP sensor, and a hybrid autofocus system. Can you create a post that highlights these features?

I created the draft and validated it against the confirmed product facts and requested constraints.

Introducing the Fujifilm X100VI! This powerful camera features a 23mm f/2 lens, a 26.1MP sensor, and a hybrid autofocus system. Capture stunning images with precision and speed. Explore the possibilities with the X100VI!

product_facts: it has a hybrid autofocus system
